description__en: Each pet earns Cash every second. Its income is its base income times its mutation multiplier and a weight factor.

description__en: A colour mutation multiplies a pet's income by a fixed amount.

description__en: Heavier pets earn more: income grows with (weight / base weight) to the power 37/60, and more slowly (power 2/5) above 125 times the base weight.

description__en: Whether a pet can carry more than one colour mutation, and how they combine, is not confirmed yet.

description__en: Each biome needs a minimum Speed to reach it; heavy eggs slow you down on the way back.
